visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a close-up of a pair of hands cutting deboned chicken thighs into bite-sized pieces on a black cutting board. The background shows a modern kitchen with a stovetop and a white bowl. (2) The chicken pieces are then placed into a white ceramic pot. Various liquids (soy sauce, sake) and powders (salt, sugar, pepper) are poured in, and the hands mix them thoroughly. (3) A mixture of cornstarch and water is added, followed by a final drizzle of oil, and mixed again. The marinated chicken is transferred to a white rectangular container with a red lid. (4) The scene shifts to prepping vegetables: a zucchini is sliced into thick rounds, tomatoes are halved, an onion is diced, and garlic is minced. The zucchini slices are salted in a metal bowl and then dried with a paper towel. (5) In a grey pan on a cooktop, oil is sprayed and the zucchini slices are seared until golden brown on both sides. They are then removed to a plate. (6) The chicken pieces are then seared in the same pan with black pepper until browned. They are also set aside. (7) Diced onions and halved cherry tomatoes are sautéed in the pan with salt and pepper. White wine and capers are added as the vegetables soften. (8) The seared chicken and zucchini are returned to the pan, along with minced garlic, and stir-fried together. Red chili flakes and balsamic vinegar are added as a finish. (9) The final dish is plated alongside white rice. A woman with short dark hair and a pink apron appears, tasting the food with chopsticks and smiling enthusiastically. The video concludes with her social media handles.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: @RosalinaKitchen. [Subtitle]: 去骨雞腿肉一份 切成一口大小. (2) [Subtitle]: 醃漬調味料： 一小撮 鹽 一小匙 糖 一小撮 胡椒 5cc醬油 15ml 清酒. (3) [Subtitle]: 充分搓揉均勻 直到水分吸收進去. (4) [Subtitle]: 一點太白粉水 保持肉質水嫩... (5) [Subtitle]: 最後一點油抓勻. (6) [Subtitle]: 先放到保鮮盒裡 移到冰箱 備用... (7) [Subtitle]: 準備一條櫛瓜 切成厚片... (8) [Subtitle]: 可用一點鹽 (0.8%) 先讓櫛瓜出水 水分減少後，櫛瓜風味會更濃. (9) [Subtitle]: 大約靜置20分鐘. (10) [Subtitle]: 小番茄對切... (11) [Subtitle]: 洋蔥剖半，切成塊狀. (12) [Subtitle]: 蒜頭剁成蒜末... (13) [Subtitle]: 將櫛瓜表面的水分擦乾. (14) [Subtitle]: 熱鍋後入油... [Subtitle]: 把櫛瓜放進來煎. (15) [Subtitle]: 大概煎到表面有這樣的焦香 翻面再煎.... (16) [Subtitle]: 另外一面也煎出焦香. (17) [Subtitle]: 先暫時取出來. (18) [Subtitle]: 接著放入雞肉進來煎 先一面煎出焦香. (19) [Subtitle]: 一點綜合胡椒調味. (20) [Subtitle]: 翻炒一下，繼續煎出焦香. (21) [Subtitle]: 等兩面都煎出焦香後 先取出來，避免雞肉變老... (22) [Subtitle]: 原來的鍋，繼續放入洋蔥. (23) [Subtitle]: 拌炒出香氣. (24) [Subtitle]: 一點鹽、胡椒調味. (25) [Subtitle]: 炒出香氣. (26) [Subtitle]: 接著放入番茄 繼續的翻炒... (27) [Subtitle]: 不需要把番茄炒到糊化 只需要把番茄炒出汁來即可. (28) [Subtitle]: 漸漸的，番茄就會變軟. (29) [Subtitle]: 加入15ml的白酒. (30) [Subtitle]: 繼續炒香. (31) [Subtitle]: 讓番茄繼續軟化... (32) [Subtitle]: 如果想呈現 異國感，可以放一些『酸豆』增加酸味. (33) [Subtitle]: 如果想吃 中式 就放一些『醬油』調味即可. (34) [Subtitle]: 大約煮2分鐘左右. (35) [Subtitle]: 把雞腿肉放回來. (36) [Subtitle]: 翻炒均勻，讓味道融合. (37) [Subtitle]: 最後再放入 『櫛瓜』跟『蒜末』. (38) [Subtitle]: 翻炒均勻.... (39) [Subtitle]: 像這樣～ 非常簡單、超好吃的 『番茄櫛瓜炒雞肉』 就完成啦～～ ❤️❤️. (40) [Subtitle]: 起鍋前.... 加點辣椒片 ❤️. (41) [Subtitle]: 還有巴薩米克醋.... 增加酸甜口感！ ❤️. (42) [Subtitle]: 拌一拌， 整個香氣都上來了 ❤️. (43) [Subtitle]: 這一道可以是『西式風味』 也可以是『中式風味』. (44) [Subtitle]: 加入的調味料不同， 就會有 不同的口味呈現喔！ ❤️. (45) [Subtitle]: 好囉～ 那我要開動囉 ❤️. [Variety]: ❤️❤️. (46) [Subtitle]: 哇～雞肉好滑、 好嫩，好好吃 ❤️❤️. visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A woman with dark hair in a short bob, wearing a white short-sleeved top and a vibrant pink apron.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A clean, modern kitchen studio with a black cooktop, white tiled walls, and various kitchenware (pots, bowls, jars) arranged neatly in the background.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with the sharp, percussive sound of rhythmic chopping on a board. A light, upbeat acoustic guitar and piano BGM starts immediately. A female voice provides instructional narration with a friendly, moderate pitch. (2) Frequent 'clinking' sounds of liquid being poured and 'squishing' sounds of hands mixing meat are clearly audible. The BGM maintains a steady, happy tempo. (3) The rhythmic chopping returns as zucchini is sliced, followed by the sound of salt being shaken and a metal bowl being rattled. (4) A loud, continuous 'sizzling' sound enters the mix as vegetables hit hot oil. This is accompanied by metallic 'clinks' of tongs. (5) The sizzling continues as chicken is seared, with the distinct sound of a manual pepper grinder being twisted. (6) A 'splash' sound indicates liquid being added to the pan. The scraping of a spatula against metal is heard as the ingredients are combined. (7) Towards the end, the sizzling fades out. The female voice increases in pitch and arousal during the tasting segment, using enthusiastic exclamations. The sound of chopsticks hitting a ceramic bowl and the 'crunch' of eating are prominent.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a quick-paced, instructional cooking tutorial for 'Tomato Zucchini Stir-fried Chicken.' It aims to showcase how easy the dish is to prepare while offering two distinct flavor profiles (Western vs. Chinese) through minor ingredient adjustments. The final tasting segment reinforces the recipe's appeal by demonstrating high satisfaction.
